# Teacher Sara

Teacher Sara is a British English teacher based in Sant Joan d'Alacant (San Juan de Alicante), Alicante, Spain.

## Services
- English classes for children aged 6–8, 9–11 and 12–14.
- Small-group English lessons with a maximum of 4 students. Group price: €12.50 per pupil per lesson when the group is full with 4 pupils.
- Individual English lessons.
- School English support: homework, tasks and projects.
- Support for Cambridge English exam goals, especially for older children and teenagers.

## Location
- Sant Joan d'Alacant / San Juan de Alicante, Alicante.
- Serves families in nearby Mutxamel as well.
- The exact home address is not published publicly.

## Teacher
- Teacher Sara is British.
- More than 15 years of English-teaching experience in Spain.
- Teaching experience includes schools in San Sebastián, Pamplona, Madrid and Alicante.
